prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection, live generation countdown timers, personality headlines, path duration hints, and account safety or persistence hints worked to improve performance.
Major redesigns, sub-flows, trait selectors, story or quality guidance copy, estimated time headlines, and reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Flow bypasses and tutorial screens yielded mixed results, winning in early tests but hurting or showing no effect in later ones.
Notifications and alerts, layout modifications, incentives, permission checks, and wait screen activity tips showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for major redesigns, sub-flows, copy overhauls, and reordering sign-in after photo upload.
Predictions underestimated gains for account safety and persistence hints, path duration hints, personality headlines, and wait countdown timers.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Previous Pet Restore Reassurance Hint: Adds an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets and saved items are automatically restored upon signing in. (why: Support mailbox received 8 complaints about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, and previous test lessons show account persistence hints strongly improve performance.)
1: [home, wait_info] Generation Safety Countdown and Restore Indicator: Displays live progress and cloud backup status alongside the generation countdown on the waiting screen. (why: Home dropoff occurs while waiting (median 201s, mean 2336s). Past lessons showed countdown timers and cloud sync indicators reduce drop-off during long wait times.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Placement Launch Verification Screen: Adds a dedicated confirmation screen right before completing onboarding to verify desktop readiness and launch status. (why: Finish step drops off at 71.6% (mean 5815s) and support received 3 tickets reporting pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to launch.)
3: [choose_path, hint] Starter Companion Fast-Track Hint: Adds a hint on the path choice screen highlighting expected setup completion time under 1 minute. (why: Choose_path has a median duration of 8s but a long mean of 514s; past lessons confirm duration hints effectively guide users forward.)
4: [adoption, copy] Customization Safety and Format Guidance Copy: Updates headline and body copy on the photo upload screen to provide clear photo quality guidelines for pet creation. (why: Adoption step drops off to 69.3% and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.)
5: [adoption, new_flow] Preset Adoption Companion Selection Flow: Introduces a grid layout flow for selecting instant pet presets to prevent generation issues and speed up customization. (why: Adoption conversion is low (69.3%) with long wait times (1017s mean), and preset selection bypasses rendering failure points.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Alert Notification: Enables desktop readiness alert notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s; notifying users when their pet is ready prevents drop-off during background generation.)
7: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Visibility Control Hint: Adds a persistent guidance hint on the home intro screen detailing tray icon controls to show, hide, or talk to the pet. (why: Support mailbox received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after setup.)

scores.note: Account persistence hints strongly perform and address top support complaints.
Live wait screen countdowns consistently recover drop-offs during long wait times.
Adding a full new verification screen has high cost and modest historical returns.
Path duration hints consistently outperform expectations with low implementation effort.
Quality guidance copy overhaul historically hurt conversion on the adoption step.
Sub-flows and major flow redesigns consistently underperform and carry high dev cost.
Notifications show neutral to mild positive impact on wait screen drop-off.
Simple control hints reduce end-of-funnel confusion with quick configuration updates.
